name: Pork-Apple Burger with Spiced Mayo & Creamy Cranberry Mixed Greens

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 Gala apples
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp mayonnaise
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter and core apples. Thinly slice half of the apples and add to the bowl with the dressing; toss to coat and set aside.
Coarsely grate the remaining apples and transfer to another large bowl.
Add pork, bread crumbs, Dijon, and spices to the bowl with the grated apple; use your hands to thoroughly combine. Form into 6 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground pork
⅓ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, place burger patties on the grill and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the spiced mayo.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
¾ tsp paprika
½ tsp garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill to toast, 1-2 minutes.
While toasting the buns, add mixed greens and cranberries to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
Place burgers on bottom of buns, spread with spiced mayo, and close with tops.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
